client_alerts.headline: OpenAI DevDay: always-on agents and unlicensed @ChatGPT mentions widen the data-exposure surface
client_alerts.body: DevDay (Sept 29) introduced **Dots** — always-on GPT-6 Astra agents with their own cloud computers and 4,000+ plug-ins — plus admin-configurable **@ChatGPT mentions in Teams and Slack that do not need individual licences**. For any client on ChatGPT Business or Enterprise, confirm who can enable these, which channels and connectors the agents can read, and whether existing retention and DLP policies cover agent activity before they are switched on.

top_moves.title: Mistral opens the enterprise Le Chat → Vibe migration window today
top_moves.body: Enterprise organisations can now move from Le Chat to the merged **Mistral Vibe** product; admins pick the date in the admin panel (or trigger it immediately) within a roughly six-month window. Clients using Mistral for EU-sovereignty reasons should schedule the cutover rather than let the window run out.

top_moves.title: OpenAI DevDay rollout: Dots agents, GPT-6.1 Sol at one-fifth the price, and a $500 Pro tier
top_moves.body: More than 20 announcements are now rolling out: always-on **Dots** agents (Pro, Business Premium, Enterprise), **GPT-6.1 Sol** with near-Astra agentic coding at one-fifth standard token pricing, Codex in the Cloud, ChatGPT Space, and a **Pro 500** plan with Astra Ultrafast. This shifts ChatGPT from a chat tool to a platform that holds standing responsibilities — a governance question as much as a capability one.

top_moves.title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Work IQ preview rolling out, web address changes in early October
top_moves.body: **Work IQ** entered preview Sept 30 and rolls out through October; remaining users are being redirected from m365.cloud.microsoft to **copilot.cloud.microsoft** in early October, and cost management extends to Copilot Studio agents this month. Any runbook, allowlist, proxy rule or SSO bookmark that names the old address needs updating.

providers.name: OpenAI
providers.headline: DevDay 2026 rollout under way: Dots always-on agents, GPT-6.1 Sol at one-fifth pricing, ChatGPT Space and a $500 Pro tier.
providers.detail: DevDay (Sept 29) brought 20+ announcements now reaching accounts. **Dots** are GPT-6 Astra agents with cloud computers and 4,000+ plug-ins, reachable from ChatGPT, Slack and Teams. **GPT-6.1 Sol** is available to API and all paid plans at one-fifth standard token pricing. Also new: Codex in the Cloud, computer use in the Agents API, ChatGPT Space, unlicensed @ChatGPT mentions in Teams/Slack for Business and Enterprise, and an **Ultrafast** speed tier (up to 8x in Codex, 6x in the API) bundled in the $500/month Pro 500 plan.
providers.alertReason: Always-on agents with 4,000+ plug-ins and unlicensed @ChatGPT mentions in Teams/Slack expand what client data the assistant can reach.

providers.name: Anthropic
providers.headline: No new ship today; Sonnet 5.5 (Sept 28) and Opus 5.5 (Sept 22) are the current state.
providers.detail: No October release has been announced. **Claude Sonnet 5.5** (Sept 28) generates output more than 30% faster than Sonnet 5, and **Opus 5.5** (Sept 22) matches Fable 5.1 on most work with a 1M-token context at 40% below Opus 5 pricing.

providers.name: Google Gemini
providers.headline: No confirmed ship today; press reports point to a Gemini 4 Pro launch in October, unconfirmed by Google.
providers.detail: Several outlets report Google may skip Gemini 3.5 Pro and launch **Gemini 4 Pro** this month, with SVG, 3D and interactive-simulation generation. This is rumour, not an announcement — treat it as a watch item and do not plan around it.

providers.name: xAI
providers.headline: Musk flags a new round of Grok upgrades today and a new Grok/X subscription model is reported; details are thin.
providers.detail: Musk posted about "many great upgrades" on Oct 1; coverage ties this to Grok 4.7 (Sept 21, 500K context), a refreshed Grokipedia and expanded team-collaboration tools. A separate report says xAI plans a **new subscription model for Grok and X**. No pricing or dates are confirmed, and Grok 5 has still not shipped.

providers.name: Meta
providers.headline: No new release today; Muse hardware announced at Connect arrives later in October from $349.
providers.detail: Muse Spark 1.3 (Sept 2) remains the flagship model and the Muse personal agent (Sept 8) the main product. New Muse hardware goes on sale later this month starting at $349.

providers.name: Mistral
providers.headline: Enterprise migration from Le Chat to the merged Mistral Vibe product opens today, with a six-month admin-controlled window.
providers.detail: Free, Pro and Teams accounts began migrating Sept 14; from **Oct 1** enterprise admins choose their own migration date in the admin panel or trigger the merge immediately, within roughly six months. Leanstral 1.5 was retired yesterday as scheduled.

providers.name: Perplexity
providers.headline: No dated ship confirmed for today; the recent Computer upgrade (Effort Mode, GPT-6 Astra, Portable and Hybrid Computer) is the current state.
providers.detail: The latest Computer release adds **Effort Mode** (Light / Standard / High / Ultra), GPT-6 Astra support, Side Chat, history search, new connectors and enterprise analytics. A Windows rollout starts with the HP ZBook Ultra G3a, expected in October.

providers.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
providers.headline: Work IQ preview rolls out through October, the Copilot web app moves to copilot.cloud.microsoft, and cost management extends to Copilot Studio agents.
providers.detail: **Work IQ** has been in preview since Sept 30. Users not redirected in September are being moved from m365.cloud.microsoft to **copilot.cloud.microsoft** in early October. Cost management expands to Copilot Studio agents this month, and a proactive view across mail, calendar, chats and tasks enters private preview.

providers.name: GitHub Copilot
providers.headline: No new ship today; Copilot CLI v1.0.89 (Sept 28) reads Claude Code rule files, and the Oct 19 model cutoff is 18 days out.
providers.detail: CLI v1.0.89 added Claude Code rule-file support and new modes. The deprecation of selected models takes effect **Oct 19** — check pinned models in workflows before then.

providers.name: Cursor
providers.headline: No new ship today.
providers.detail: Nothing new surfaced in the last 48 hours. Cursor 3 with the Agents Window and Background Agents remains the current state.

providers.name: Gamma
providers.headline: Still quiet — no update since the June 12 Gamma Agent/3.0 launch.

providers.name: Notion AI
providers.headline: No new ship today; Notion 3.7 agent skills (Sept 15) remain the latest state.
providers.detail: No new release found in the last 48 hours.

Microsoft 365 Copilot — spend and cost controls — 2 weeks running (Cowork billing last week, Copilot Studio agent cost management this month)

month_themes.then: Model retirements (GitHub Copilot dropping six models); pricing holds (Sonnet 5 promo made permanent); security hardening (OpenAI Daybreak hardware keys).
month_themes.now: Always-on agents with standing responsibilities (OpenAI Dots); forced platform migrations (Le Chat → Vibe, Copilot web address); near-flagship quality at a fraction of the price (GPT-6.1 Sol, Opus 5.5).

habits.shift: Stay on Opus 5.5 for long plan documents (1M context, 40% cheaper than Opus 5). Sweep existing runbooks for the old m365.cloud.microsoft Copilot address.
Sonnet 5.5 is 30%+ faster for clause-by-clause summaries; always verify clause numbers against the source standard.
Use Effort Mode High or Ultra for vendor due diligence, Light for quick fact checks.
GPT-6.1 Sol is worth a side-by-side trial on a non-confidential draft now that it is on every paid plan at one-fifth token cost.
No change — Gamma has shipped nothing since June; keep the current workflow.

community.so_what: The standing theme is unchanged: open-weight models that run on ~17 GB VRAM keep closing the gap, which matters for clients who need an offline or air-gapped fallback.

No community signal to act on; Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 remain the reference points.

watch.title: NIST SP 1353 comment period closes Oct 15
watch.body: The quick-start guide on using AI for Cybersecurity Framework analysis and reporting is open for comment until Oct 15. CSA has noted that it does not address data exposure.

watch.title: GitHub Copilot model cutoff — Oct 19
watch.body: Selected models are removed on Oct 19. Check any pinned model in CI workflows or agent configurations.

watch.title: Gemini 4 Pro rumoured for October
watch.body: Unconfirmed press reports only. If it ships, expect another re-ranking against GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1.

watch.title: xAI subscription changes
watch.body: A new subscription model for Grok and X is reported but unpriced. Hold any Grok plan purchase until terms are published.

watch.title: Mistral Vibe enterprise migration window
watch.body: Opened Oct 1 and runs about six months. Clients on Mistral should pick a date and test before the forced merge.
